title: All the vehicles
description: A mod pack full of vehicle mods, and it's kitted for private multiplayer!
body:
A mod pack full of vehicle mods, and it's kitted for private multiplayer! All the vehicles now has an official minecraft server
[Server Page](https://modrinth.com/server/all-the-vehicles-server) # Features ## Multiplayer With essential mod, you can host your own minecraft world, just like on bedrock edition. And there is built in voice chat so you can chat with your friends. ## Vehicles This server has vehicles like planes and cars. ## Signs There are a lot of signs you can use, like stop signs, yield signs and a whole bunch of others. ## More Concrete The more concrete mod allows for concrete slabs. So now you can make easy slopes with road markings.
